English.Char_Desc_250: ReelGeek turns a folder of photos into a vertical edit rather than a slideshow. Cuts land on a tempo grid, the camera moves on every shot, and the output is a 1080x1920 MP4 ready for TikTok and Shorts. Nothing is uploaded.
English.Char_Desc_450: ReelGeek turns a folder of photos into a vertical video edit on your own machine. Cuts land on a tempo grid you can match to your track, every shot gets a real camera move, and the transitions are the ones short-form editors use: whip pans with directional motion blur, snap zooms, flash frames and glitch cuts. Five styles, a re-roll button for a fresh edit from the same photos, and a 1080x1920 MP4 out. No account, no watermark, no upload.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
ReelGeek turns a folder of photos into a vertical edit, not a slideshow.
Drop your photos in, pick one of five styles, type a hook for the first two seconds, and ReelGeek builds a cut list against a tempo grid, gives every shot its own camera move and picks a transition out of each one. Output is 1080x1920 H.264 MP4, which uploads as-is to TikTok and YouTube Shorts.
The five styles each change the rhythm, the transitions and the colour grade: Hype is fast and aggressive, Clean is minimal, Soft is dreamy, VHS is a retro camcorder look, and Luxe is slow and cinematic with fewer cuts.
Every frame is composed in Python and piped into ffmpeg as raw pixels rather than assembled from stock filters. That is what makes the harder moves possible: a whip pan with genuine directional motion blur, or an RGB-split glitch with displaced scanlines, cannot be done with a filter chain.
Re-roll produces a completely new edit from the same photos and style, so you can roll it three or four times and keep the best. Quick preview renders a low-res draft in seconds so you can judge the rhythm before committing.
No music is baked in, on purpose. Adding trending audio inside TikTok or Instagram gets better distribution and keeps you clear of copyright claims, so ReelGeek gives you a silent file and lines the cuts up to a BPM you set.
No account, no upload, no telemetry, no watermark and no export limit. Your photos and your videos never leave the machine. Free, including at work. GPL-3.0.
